analysis: Adrenal insufficiency is characterized by decreased production of aldosterone and cortisol. This results in hyponatremia due to reduced sodium reabsorption and hyperkalemia due to decreased potassium excretion. Additionally, the lack of cortisol leads to hypoglycemia because of impaired gluconeogenesis. Metabolic acidosis, rather than alkalosis, is typically associated with adrenal insufficiency due to decreased hydrogen ion excretion. Therefore, metabolic alkalosis is not associated with adrenal insufficiency, as the condition usually leads to metabolic acidosis.
